issues.concern: The headword '痛み' has three distinct senses, only one of which (sense 2: emotional pain) is accurately described by the 'emotion' tag. Sense 1 (physical pain) is better described by 'descriptive' or 'general', and sense 3 (damage/wear) is not related to emotion at all.
issues.suggestion: Remove 'emotion' tag. Add 'general' or 'descriptive' as a more encompassing tag for the headword, or add 'descriptive' and 'existence' to cover the physical and damage senses.
